title: llm-usage-metrics context report output (v1)
description: Envelope and payload for context report --json output (model rows, or session rows with --by-session).

longContextPromptTokens.description: Prompt size above which a request counts as long-context.

nearLimitShare.description: Share of the context limit above which a request counts as near it.

rows.description: Rows ordered by peak prompt, largest first; with --by-session, the top sessions only.

aggregatedSources.description: Sources whose usage records sum several requests; they have no rows.

pressure.description: Prompt sizes over the row's requests.

requests.description: Usage records of the row; each records one request.

peakPromptTokens.description: Largest prompt of one request: input, cache read and cache write tokens.

longContextRequests.description: Requests whose prompt is above longContextPromptTokens.

longContextExtraUsd.description: What long-context tier rates added to the estimated cost: cost at the tier rates minus cost at the base rates. null when no request was priced (unknown model, or --cost-mode explicit).

longContextExtraIncomplete.description: True when some request had no pricing, so longContextExtraUsd may be low.

nearLimitRequests.description: Requests whose prompt is above nearLimitShare of their model's context limit; null when no request's limit is known.

modelRow.description: One model across the per-request sources.

model.description: Model name as logged; null when the records name none.

contextLimit.description: LiteLLM max_input_tokens for the model; null when unknown.

sessionRow.description: One session of a per-request source (--by-session).

source.description: Source id the session came from.

repoRoot.description: Working directory the tool recorded for the session; omitted when unknown.

models.description: Models the session's requests name, sorted.
